readings.description: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that was made.

reading.title: The One Who Will Crush the Serpent

readings.description: The promise of the one who will crush the serpent's head, foreshadowing Christ's victory over sin and Satan.
The ultimate defeat of Satan and the victory of Christ over the serpent.
God's promise to Abraham that all nations will be blessed through his offspring.
The fulfillment of the promise to bless all nations, including the Gentiles, through Christ.
The institution of the Passover, a foreshadowing of Christ's sacrifice.
Christ as the fulfillment of the Passover lamb, sacrificed for our sins.
The Day of Atonement ritual, pointing to Christ's atoning work.
Christ's superior sacrifice that replaces the old covenant system.
The finality and completeness of Christ's sacrifice for sins.
God's promise to David of an eternal kingdom and throne.
The announcement of Jesus, the Son of David, to Mary.
The psalm foretelling the reign of God's anointed King.
The ultimate victory and reign of Christ the King.
David's psalm of suffering, which foreshadows Christ's suffering on the cross.
The fulfillment of the suffering prophecies in Christ's crucifixion.
Isaiah's prophecies of the coming child who will be Immanuel and the promised Messiah.
The genealogy and birth announcement of Jesus, the fulfillment of Isaiah's prophecy.
The prophecy of the suffering servant who would bear our sins and bring us peace.
Christ's final words on the cross and His burial, completing the work of salvation.
God's promise of a new covenant, written on the heart, replacing the old.

reading.title: The Mediator of the New Covenant

readings.description: Christ as the mediator of the new covenant, established through His blood.
Christ's resurrection and the significance of His incarnation—God becoming man.

reading.title: The Fullness of God in Him

readings.description: The deity of Christ and the fullness of God dwelling in Him.
The birth of Jesus in Bethlehem, announced to the shepherds, fulfilling all the promises and prophecies.
